description: The source reports eviscerated chicken weights in tonnes for registered slaughter stations in Alberta, split into birds below 1 kg, 1–2 kgand 2 kgor more. Two XLSX descriptors span 2002–2014 and 2003–2015. These are throughput observations for food-processing facilities, distinct from general live-animal population statistics. Facility-level identifiers, processing technology and within-year observation frequency are not stated. The overlapping releases are grouped and no numerical equality between them has been checked. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
